products.summary: The Enviro 2” Water Structuring Device is a maintenance-free, chemical-free solution designed for high-flow residential, commercial, and industrial water systems. It helps reduce hard water scaling, protects equipment and plumbing, and operates without electricity, salt, filters, or replacement parts.
products.description:
Key Features
Fully Automatic Operation
No Moving Parts
No Electricity Required
No Chemicals or Salt Usage
No Filters or Consumables
Minimal Maintenance

About Product
The Enviro 2” Water Structuring Device is a fully automatic water conditioning solution designed for larger residential, commercial, and industrial applications. It helps reduce the scale-forming properties of hard water without using chemicals, salt, or electricity.
The system protects pipelines, plumbing fixtures, water heaters, boilers, cooling systems, and other equipment from mineral buildup, helping to extend their service life and improve operational efficiency.
It minimizes mineral deposits on fixtures and surfaces, reducing maintenance and cleaning requirements while keeping water systems running smoothly.
With no moving parts, filters, or consumables, the device offers hassle-free operation, minimal maintenance, and no recurring replacement costs.
Ideal for apartment complexes, residential communities, hotels, hospitals, educational institutions, commercial buildings, and industrial process water systems, it provides a reliable and eco-friendly solution for hard water management.
By naturally conditioning water and reducing scale formation, the Enviro 2” Water Structuring Device helps maintain cleaner plumbing systems, improves equipment longevity, and supports efficient water usage for high-flow applications.

Geyser: Protects from Lime Scale and extends its life. Gives Conditioned/Polished water (Lime-scale Free).

About Product
Enviro Brine+ Hard Water Conditioner is designed to protect homes from the damaging effects of hard water caused by high levels of calcium and magnesium minerals commonly found in borewell water.
It helps reduce white scaling and mineral deposits on taps, showerheads, bathroom tiles, pipelines, geysers, and other household appliances, keeping your home cleaner and better protected.
The advanced conditioning technology utilizes a proprietary process that alters the behavior of calcium minerals, helping them remain in a non-adherent state and reducing their tendency to form hard scale deposits inside pipes and on surfaces.
By minimizing scaling and corrosion, the system helps extend the lifespan of plumbing networks, geyser heating elements, washing machines, and other utility equipment.
It also improves the bathing experience by reducing the harsh effects of hard water on skin and hair, contributing to a cleaner and healthier living environment.
The conditioner operates without chemicals and features odourless, tasteless, and pH-neutral media, making it suitable for residential borewell water applications.
Ideal for independent houses, villas, apartments, farmhouses, residential complexes, and utility water lines, Enviro Brine+ delivers reliable performance with minimal maintenance requirements.

The 250 Litre Stainless Steel (SS) Water Storage Tank is a durable and hygienic solution for storing clean water in residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Manufactured from high-quality food-grade stainless steel, the tank is designed to resist rust, corrosion, and contamination, ensuring that stored water remains safe, fresh, and odor-free. With a 250-litre capacity, this tank is suitable for homes, apartments, offices, restaurants, hospitals, schools, and small commercial establishments. Its leak-proof welded construction ensures reliable performance, while the polished finish enhances durability and complements modern installations.
Designed for long-term performance, the 250 Litre SS Tank withstands varying weather conditions and maintains the quality of stored water without affecting its taste or odor. With a purification capacity of 15 litres per hour, it is ideal for small to medium families.
The system includes a 5-micron sediment filter, a 100 GPD imported pump, and a 100 GPD RO membrane to ensure consistent pressure and efficient filtration. Coconut shell activated carbon (1100 IV) improves taste and removes odors, while the 5W UVC LED provides additional microbial safety. A Bio AA+ Alkaline filter enhances pH levels, supporting healthier hydration.
Featuring an auto TDS screen with real-time TDS display and an automatic TDS adjuster, the purifier intelligently maintains optimal mineral balance. With a 10-litre storage tank, flexible wall-mount or table-top installation, and a durable ABS premium-grade cabinet, the Kraft Auto TDS offers smart functionality, reliability, and modern design in one compact unit.

The 5G PRO Hot, Ambient & Cold Alkaline Water Purifier is a premium, all-in-one water purification system designed to deliver safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water with the convenience of instant hot, ambient, and cold water. Combining advanced purification technology with a sleek glass-finish design and an intelligent touch panel, this purifier is the perfect addition to modern homes, offices, and commercial spaces.
Powered by an advanced RO + UV + UF + Alkaline multi-stage purification process, the purifier effectively removes excess Total Dissolved Solids (TDS), dissolved salts, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals, harmful chemicals, pesticides, and other contaminants while retaining essential minerals for healthier drinking water. It is suitable for treating raw water with TDS levels up to 3000 PPM and delivers a purification capacity of 15 litres per hour, ensuring a continuous supply of purified water for your family.

The 4-inch UF Filter provides an additional layer of filtration by removing fine suspended particles and microorganisms without affecting beneficial minerals.
For superior microbial protection, the purifier is equipped with a powerful 5W UVC LED In-Tank Sterilization System, which continuously disinfects stored water and prevents bacterial growth inside the storage tank, ensuring every glass of water remains hygienic even after storage.
The integrated Bio AA+ Alkaline Filter enriches purified water with essential minerals such as calcium and magnesium while balancing the pH level to produce healthy alkaline drinking water that supports better hydration and improved taste.
One of the standout features of the 5G PRO is its Vegetable Detoxifier, which helps remove pesticide residues, harmful chemicals, and surface contaminants from fruits and vegetables, providing an additional level of protection for your family's daily food preparation.
The purifier is equipped with a modern Touch Panel featuring Real-Time TDS Monitoring, allowing users to easily monitor the quality of purified water. A Manual TDS Adjuster enables precise control over mineral retention, allowing you to customize the taste and mineral content according to your local water conditions and personal preference.
Designed for maximum convenience, the purifier includes separate storage tanks for multiple temperature options:
4 Litres Ambient Water
1 Litre Hot Water
0.8 Litre Cold Water
Whether you need chilled drinking water during summer, hot water for tea, coffee, or instant foods, or ambient water for everyday hydration, the 5G PRO delivers water instantly at your preferred temperature.
The purifier operates using an energy-efficient SMPS Power Supply (220V AC / 24V DC – 30W). Power consumption is optimized with 30W during RO purification, 550W while heating, 60W during cooling, and only 5W for the Vegetable Detoxifier, ensuring reliable performance with efficient energy usage.
Constructed with a Premium ABS Food-Grade Cabinet and an elegant tempered glass front panel, the 5G PRO offers excellent durability, easy maintenance, and a sophisticated appearance that complements any modern kitchen or workspace. Its versatile Wall Mountable and Table Top installation options provide flexibility to suit different spaces and user requirements.
Combining intelligent technology, multi-stage purification, alkaline mineral enhancement, hot and cold dispensing, UVC in-tank protection, and a premium aesthetic design, the 5G PRO Hot, Ambient & Cold Alkaline Water Purifierdelivers a complete drinking water solution for families seeking safety, convenience, performance, and style.

This advanced KENT RO Water Purifier features a powerful
RO + UV + UF + Alkaline + Copper + TDS Control purification
system that removes bacteria, viruses, chemicals, heavy metals, and dissolved
impurities while retaining essential natural minerals. It delivers 100% pure,
safe, and healthy drinking water that meets IS:10500 drinking water standards.
Equipped with IoT-powered smart monitoring, the purifier
allows you to monitor water quality, filter life, service alerts, and system
performance directly from your smartphone, providing complete control anytime,
anywhere.
The advanced TDS Control system preserves essential minerals,
while the Alkaline Technology enriches water with a pH level
between 8.0 and 9.5 to support better hydration and overall wellness. The
Active Copper Technology further enhances the purified water
with the goodness of copper.
With a purification capacity of up to 20 litres per hour and
a large 11 litre transparent detachable storage tank, it
ensures a continuous supply of clean water and makes tank cleaning easy. The
digital display provides real-time information about water purity, filter
status, and purifier performance.
Backed by a 1 Year Warranty and 3 Years Free
Service, KENT continues to be trusted by more than 1 crore satisfied
consumers across India and is certified by both NSF and
ISI for quality, safety, and reliability.

This RO + UV + UF Water Purifier is designed to provide safe and healthy drinking water for your home with advanced multi-stage purification technology. With a purification capacity of 15 litres per hour, it ensures a continuous and reliable supply of clean water for daily household use.
The system begins with a 5 micron sediment filter that removes dust, sand, and rust particles, protecting internal components. A powerful 100 GPD imported pump and 100 GPD RO membrane effectively reduce TDS, heavy metals, chemicals, and dissolved impurities. The coconut shell activated carbon (1100 IV) improves the taste, color, and odor of water by removing chlorine and other harmful substances.
For enhanced safety, the purifier features a UVC LED with SS barrel, which helps eliminate bacteria and keeps stored water hygienic. The 4-inch UF filter adds an extra layer of fine filtration for additional protection. A manual TDS adjuster allows you to maintain essential minerals according to input water quality. It comes with a large 14-litre storage tank, supports wall mountable or table top installation, and is built with ABS premium-grade storage tank and cabinet quality. The energy-efficient 220V AC / 24V DC – 30W SMPS power supply ensures stable and long-lasting performance.

Combining advanced purification technology with a sleek glass-finish design and an intelligent touch panel, this purifier is the perfect addition to modern homes, offices, and commercial spaces.
Powered by an advanced RO + UV + UF + Alkaline multi-stage purification process, the purifier effectively removes excess Total Dissolved Solids (TDS), dissolved salts, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals, harmful chemicals, pesticides, and other contaminants while retaining essential minerals for healthier drinking water. For superior microbial protection, the purifier is equipped with a powerful 5W UVC LED In-Tank Sterilization System, which continuously disinfects stored water and prevents bacterial growth inside the storage tank, ensuring every glass of water remains hygienic even after storage.
The integrated Bio AA+ Alkaline Filter enriches purified water with essential minerals such as calcium and magnesium while balancing the pH level to produce healthy alkaline drinking water that supports better hydration and improved taste.
One of the standout features of the 5G PRO is its Vegetable Detoxifier, which helps remove pesticide residues, harmful chemicals, and surface contaminants from fruits and vegetables, providing an additional level of protection for your family's daily food preparation.
The purifier is equipped with a modern Touch Panel featuring Real-Time TDS Monitoring, allowing users to easily monitor the quality of purified water. A Manual TDS Adjuster enables precise control over mineral retention, allowing you to customize the taste and mineral content according to your local water conditions and personal preference.
Designed for maximum convenience, the purifier includes separate storage tanks for multiple temperature options:
4 Litres Ambient Water
1 Litre Hot Water
0.8 Litre Cold Water

Constructed with a Premium ABS Food-Grade Cabinet and an elegant tempered glass front panel, the 5G PRO offers excellent durability, easy maintenance, and a sophisticated appearance that complements any modern kitchen or workspace. Its versatile Wall Mountable and Table Top installation options provide flexibility to suit different spaces and user requirements.
Combining intelligent technology, multi-stage purification, alkaline mineral enhancement, hot and cold dispensing, UVC in-tank protection, and a premium aesthetic design, the 5G PRO Hot, Ambient & Cold Alkaline Water Purifierdelivers a complete drinking water solution for families seeking safety, convenience, performance, and style.

5th Gen UV LED – Instant purification with a long-lasting, mercury-free UV system.
Active Copper Technology – Enriches water with Copper, Magnesium, and Calcium.

Ideal for Municipal Water – Suitable for water with TDS up to 200 ppm.

products.description:
Aquaguard Premier is an advanced RO water purifier featuring UV E-Boiling, Active Copper + Zinc Booster, and alkaline technology. It effectively removes impurities, heavy metals, bacteria, and viruses while enriching water with essential minerals. With smart alerts, 5-litre storage, long cartridge life, and wall/tabletop installation, it offers safe, convenient, and reliable drinking water for modern homes.
Key Features
Active Copper + Zinc Booster Technology – Enriches water with copper and zinc while the alkaline cartridge enhances pH and taste.
UV E-Boiling Technology – Provides water as safe and pure as water boiled for over 20 minutes.
Advanced RO Purification – Helps remove heavy metals such as lead and mercury, along with bacteria and viruses.
Smart Purifier Alerts – Alerts you about errors, service requirements, and cartridge replacement.
High Storage Capacity – Built-in storage tank keeps purified water readily available.
Smart LED Indication – Indicates tank-full status, filter life, service reminders, and errors.
Flexible Installation – Suitable for both wall mounting and tabletop installation.
Long Cartridge Life – Up to 1 year or 6,000 litres, under standard test conditions.
Energy-Saving Mode – UV lamp automatically switches off after 10 minutes of non-use.
RO Membrane Warranty – Free cleaning or replacement for up to 1 year or 6,000 litres.
